ability.name: User and Password Policy Enumeration
ability.description: Lists all domain users and retrieves the domain password policy via ADSI to ensure safe operational planning.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\Windows\Temp\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $searcher = [adsisearcher]'(objectCategory=person)'; $searcher.PageSize = 1000; $users = $searcher.FindAll(); $users | ForEach-Object { $_.Properties.samaccountname } | Out-File -FilePath $d\users.txt; $domainEntry = [ADSI]''; $maxPwdAge = $domainEntry.Properties.maxpwdage; Write-Output "Max Password Age: $maxPwdAge" | Out-File -FilePath $d\password_policy.txt } catch { "ERROR: $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d\user_enumeration_out.txt

rationale: Fulfills the critical requirement of documenting domain users and policies prior to any access attempts.
